Definition: to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to run; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to run; 1a2) runners (participle as subst); 1b) (Polel) to run swiftly, dart; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to bring or move quickly, hurry; 1c2) to drive away from, cause to run away
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
